# GUI Interface Description

## 1. Operating System Environment
- **Top Bar (System Bar)**:
  - Located at the very top of the screen.
  - Displays the following:
    - **"Activities"** button on the left.
    - **Application Name**: "Chromium Web Browser" in the center.
    - **Date and Time**: "Mar 22 05:54" displayed in the center-right.
    - **System Icons**: 
      - Notification bell icon.
      - Power icon on the far right.

- **Left Sidebar (Dock)**:
  - Vertical application launcher on the left side of the screen.
  - Contains the following icons (from top to bottom):
    - Chromium browser icon (highlighted as the active application).
    - Thunderbird mail client icon.
    - Visual Studio Code icon.
    - LibreOffice Writer icon.
    - LibreOffice Calc icon.
    - LibreOffice Impress icon.
    - GIMP icon.
    - File manager icon.
    - Software updater or settings icon.
    - Help icon.
    - Trash/recycle bin icon.

---

## 2. Chromium Browser Interface
- **Window Title Bar**:
  - Displays the title: "New Tab - Chromium".
  - Contains the following controls on the right:
    - Minimize button.
    - Maximize/restore button.
    - Close button.

- **Tab Bar**:
  - Located below the title bar.
  - Displays a single open tab labeled "New Tab".
  - Contains a "+" button to open a new tab.

- **Address Bar**:
  - Located below the tab bar.
  - Contains the following elements:
    - Back button (left arrow).
    - Forward button (right arrow).
    - Reload button (circular arrow).
    - Address/search input field with a blue outline.
    - Star icon for bookmarking.
    - Profile icon on the far right.

- **Bookmarks Bar**:
  - Located below the address bar.
  - Displays a single folder labeled "Favorites".

---

## 3. Main Browser Content Area
- **Google Search Page**:
  - Displays the Google logo in the center.
  - Below the logo:
    - Search bar with the placeholder text: "Search Google or type a URL".
    - Microphone icon for voice search.
    - Camera icon for image search.

- **Shortcut Icons**:
  - Two circular icons below the search bar:
    - "Web Store" icon.
    - "Add shortcut" icon with a "+" symbol.

- **Top Right Links**:
  - Located in the top-right corner of the content area:
    - "Gmail" link.
    - "Images" link.
    - Grid icon for Google apps.

- **Bottom Right Button**:
  - "Customize Chromium" button.

---

## 4. Mouse Pointer
- Visible as a black arrow, pointing to the right side of the screen near the "Add shortcut" icon.
